Ather service schedule and costs

An Ather needs far less servicing than a petrol scooter, but it still needs some. Here is how often, what gets checked, what parts typically cost, and how to book with us.

Updated 12 November 2026 · 2 min read · Pillai Auto, authorised Ather dealer

Ather service schedule and costs

On this page

  1. How often
  2. What gets checked
  3. Typical parts prices
  4. Ather Care plans
  5. Servicing with us

How often

ModelPeriodic serviceNotes
450S / 450X / 450 ApexEvery 5,000 km or 6 monthsSteering bearings lubricated every 10,000 km / 12 months
Rizta S / ZEvery 5,000 km or 6 monthsSame schedule as the 450
KonarcOnce a yearSealed Silent Gear Drive, no belt

These follow Ather's published guidance; your scooter's app shows the next due date.

What gets checked

Ather's periodic service is a multi-point inspection plus a wash. It covers the drive belt and pulleys (on belt-driven models), tyres and brakes, brake fluid, suspension, wheel bearings and seals, chassis fasteners, and a software check with the latest updates installed. Battery diagnostics are run when you report a range or overnight charge-drop concern.

Typical parts prices

Ather lists these indicative prices, including GST, for the 450 series and Rizta:

Part450 seriesRizta
Front brake pad₹370₹349
Rear brake pad₹260₹260
Primary belt₹999₹999
Secondary belt₹1,499₹1,499

Prices change from time to time; we confirm them on your job card before starting work.

Ather Care plans

Ather offers prepaid care plans. Ather Care covers the essentials for 1 year or 10,000 km, including two free periodic maintenance sessions and a discount on wear-and-tear parts and labour. Care Plus adds a polish and a wash with bigger discounts, and Care Max adds free brake pad replacements, belt lubrication, washes, polishing and ExpressCare sessions. Ask us which plan matches your yearly kilometres.

Servicing with us

All four Pillai Auto showrooms — Chennai OMR, Chengalpattu, Puducherry and Chidambaram — have service bays. Book through the Ather app or on our service page. Periodic maintenance is usually same-day, and an express service takes about an hour.

Questions we get asked

Ather's guidance is a periodic inspection every 5,000 km or 6 months, whichever comes first.

Once a year. Its sealed Silent Gear Drive removes the belt that needs regular checks on other models.

Ather's guidance is to replace the belt at 50,000 km, with tension and condition checked at every service.
